key_facts: The skin condition has progressively worsened
The condition involves 90% of her body surface area
There are widespread polycyclic serpiginous, erythematous plaques on the trunk and extremities
The plaques involve 30% of the body surface area
The patient has sparse and short eyebrow hairs
The patient has coarse and brittle scalp hairs
Skin biopsy showed psoriasiform epidermal hyperplasia with spongiosis
Trichography showed nodal swelling, with invagination of the distal hair into the proximal end

raw.rationale: The combination of psoriasiform epidermal hyperplasia with spongiosis on skin biopsy, trichography showing nodal swelling and invagination of the distal hair into the proximal end, and the patient's sparse and short eyebrow hairs along with coarse and brittle scalp hairs are characteristic of Netherton syndrome.

rejected.label: Psoriasis
rejected.why: While the skin biopsy shows psoriasiform epidermal hyperplasia, the presence of hair abnormalities and specific trichography findings are more indicative of Netherton syndrome.

rejected.label: Pityriasis rubra pilaris
rejected.why: This condition typically presents with palmoplantar keratoderma and follicular hyperkeratosis, which are not mentioned in the key facts.

rejected.label: Ichthyosis linearis circumflexa
rejected.why: A condition associated with Netherton syndrome but the key facts suggest a more complex presentation than just ichthyosis linearis circumflexa.

rejected.label: Atopic dermatitis
rejected.why: The presence of psoriasiform epidermal hyperplasia and specific hair abnormalities are not typical of atopic dermatitis.
